summary: This script starts a Docusaurus development server with HTTPS enabled. It loads some helper functions first, then runs the Yarn start command with SSL certificates and binds to all network interfaces so you can access it from other machines.

explanations.2: This line makes the script exit immediately if any command fails, treat undefined variables as errors, and handle pipe failures properly — basically making the script more robust and less forgiving of mistakes.
explanations.5: This pulls in a separate file of reusable bash functions so this script can use them.
